Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the sideswipe collision you
were involved in while changing lanes in Sugar Land, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?
A: Yes, I understand.
Q: Please state where you were driving and what you were doing right before the impact.
A: I was in the right lane on a four-lane road, heading toward the highway. I checked my mirror, signaled, and started
moving into the left lane to get around a slow truck.
Q: When you moved over, what did you see?
A: I glanced over my shoulder and thought the lane was clear, but a silver sedan came up from behind me and
clipped the side of my car. I felt the jolt and my car pulled slightly to the right.
Q: Did you or the other driver stop after the contact?
A: Yes, we both pulled onto the shoulder. The other driver got out and we exchanged information right away.
Q: Did you feel any injury at the scene?
A: Not right away. I was shaken up, but I figured I was fine. By that evening my neck was stiff and the pain started
spreading into my shoulders. It got worse over the next day or two.
Q: Have you sought medical care since the collision?
A: Yes, I saw my doctor and I've been going to physical therapy twice a week. The doctor said it looks like whiplash
from the sudden jerk of the impact.
Q: Is three anything else you'd like to add about the accident?
A: Only that I was careful with my signal and mirror check. I just didn't expect the car to come up so fast.
Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page

- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.
